title: Chapter 8 – Akṣara-Brahma Yoga (The Yoga of the Imperishable Absolute)
subtitle: Yoga of Imperishable Brahman

verses.title: 8.1 kim tad brahma kim
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच ।
किं तद् ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ॥ ८-१॥
verses.roman:
arjuna uvāca
kiṃ tad brahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama
adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate 8-1
verses.colloquial:
arjuna uvaacha
kim tad brahma kim adhyaatmam kim karma purusha uttama
adhibhuutam cha kim proktam adhidaivam kim uchyate 8-1
verses.translation_reworded: Arjuna said: What is that BRAHMAN? What is the ADHYATMA? What is action? O best of men, what is said to be the ADHIBHUTA, and what is meant by ADHIDAIVA?

verses.title: 8.2 adhiyajnah katham
verses.sanskrit:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन ।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ॥ ८-२॥
verses.roman:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko'tra dehe'sminmadhusūdana
prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo'si niyatātmabhiḥ 8-2
verses.colloquial:
adhiyajnah katham ko'tra dehe'smin madhusuudana
prayaana kaale cha katham jneyo'si niyata aatmabhih 8-2
verses.translation_reworded: O destroyer of Madhu, who is the ADHIYAJNA here in this body, and in what way? And how are You to be known by the self-controlled at the hour of death?

verses.title: 8.3 aksharam brahma paramam
verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच ।
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥ ८-३॥
verses.roman:
śrībhagavānuvāca
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo'dhyātmamucyate
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ 8-3
verses.colloquial:
shrii bhagavaan uvaacha
aksharam brahma paramam svabhaavah adhyaatma uchyate
bhuuta bhaava udbhava karah visargah karma samjnitah 8-3
verses.translation_reworded: The Blessed Lord said: BRAHMAN is the Imperishable, the Supreme. His essential nature is called Self-knowledge. The creative force that brings beings forth into manifestation is called work.

verses.title: 8.4 adhibhutam ksharo
verses.sanskrit:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् ।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ॥ ८-४॥
verses.roman:
adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam
adhiyajño'hamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara 8-4
verses.colloquial:
adhibhuutam ksharo bhaavah purushash cha adhidaivatam
adhiyajnah aham eva atra dehe dehabhritaam vara 8-4
verses.translation_reworded: The ADHIBHUTA (the elements) is My perishable nature, and the Indweller (the essence) is the ADHIDAIVATA. O best of embodied beings, I alone am the ADHIYAJNA here in this body.

verses.title: 8.5 anta-kale cha mam
verses.sanskrit:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥ ८-५॥
verses.roman:
antakāle ca māmeva smaranmuktvā kalevaram
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ 8-5
verses.colloquial:
antakaale cha maameva smaran muktvaa kalevaram
yah prayaati sa madbhaavam yaati naasti atra samshayah 8-5
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever leaves the body and departs at the moment of death remembering Me alone reaches My being. There is no doubt about this.

verses.title: 8.6 yam yam vapi smaran
verses.sanskrit:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् ।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥ ८-६॥
verses.roman:
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram
taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ 8-6
verses.colloquial:
yam yam vaapi smaran bhaavam tyajatyante kalevaram
tam tam eva iti kaunteya sadaa tad bhaava bhaavitah 8-6
verses.translation_reworded: O Kaunteya (son of Kunti), whatever being a person thinks of at the end when leaving the body, to that being alone he goes, because of his constant dwelling on it.

verses.title: 8.7 tasmat sarveshu kaleshu
verses.sanskrit:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च । 
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर् र्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम् ॥ ८- ७॥
verses.roman:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca
mayyarpitamanobuddhir māmevaiṣyasya saṃśayaḥ 8-7
verses.colloquial:
tasmaat sarveshu kaaleshu maam anusmara yudhya cha
mayy arpita mano buddhir maam eva eshyasi asamshayah 8-7
verses.translation_reworded: So remember Me at all times and fight, with mind and intellect fixed on (or absorbed in) Me. You will surely come to Me alone.

verses.title: 8.8 abhyasa-yoga-yuktena
verses.sanskrit:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ॥ ८-८॥
verses.roman:
abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan 8-8
verses.colloquial:
abhyaasa yoga yuktena chetasaa naanya gaaminaa
paramam purusham divyam yaati paartha anuchintayan 8-8
verses.translation_reworded: O Partha, with the mind made steady by the discipline of regular meditation, turning toward nothing else, and constantly meditating on the Supreme PURUSHA, the Resplendent One, a person goes (to Him).

verses.title: 8.9 kavim puranam
verses.sanskrit:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितार-
मणोरणीयंसमनुस्मरेद्यः ।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूप-
मादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ॥ ८-९॥
verses.roman:
kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāra-
maṇoraṇīyaṃsamanusmaredyaḥ
sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpa-
mādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt 8-9
verses.colloquial:
kavim puraanam anushaasitaara-
mano raniiyam samanusmared yah
sarvasya dhaataaram achintya ruupa-
maaditya varnam tamasah parastaat 8-9
verses.translation_reworded: Whoever meditates on the All-knowing, the Ancient, the Ruler (of the whole world), smaller than the atom, the Support of everything, whose Form cannot be conceived, shining like the Sun and beyond the darkness (of ignorance) . . .

verses.title: 8.10 prayana-kale manas
verses.sanskrit:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन
भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव ।
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्
स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम् ॥ ८-१०॥
verses.roman:
prayāṇakāle manasā'calena
bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak
sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam 8-10
verses.colloquial:
prayaana kaale manasaa'chalena
bhaktyaa yukto yoga balena chaiva
bhruvoh madhye praanam aaveshya samyak
sa tam param purusham upaiti divyam 8-10
verses.translation_reworded: At the time of death, with an unwavering mind full of devotion, and using the power of YOGA to settle the whole PRANA (breath) between the two eyebrows, he (the seeker) reaches the Supreme Resplendent PURUSHA.

verses.title: 8.11 yad aksharam veda-vido
verses.sanskrit:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति
विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः ।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति
तत्ते पदं सङ्ग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ॥ ८-११॥
verses.roman:
yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti
viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti
tatte padaṃ saṅgraheṇa pravakṣye 8-11
verses.colloquial:
yad aksharam vedavido vadanti
vishanti yad yatayo viitaraagaah
yad icchanto brahmacharyam charanti
tat te padam sangrahena pravakshye 8-11
verses.translation_reworded: That which the knowers of the VEDA call the Imperishable; That which the self-controlled and desire-free enter; That for whose sake BRAHMACHARYA is practised: that Goal I will describe to you briefly.

verses.title: 8.12 sarva-dvarani sanyamya
verses.sanskrit:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च ।
मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम् ॥ ८-१२॥
verses.roman:
sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca
mūrdhnyādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇamāsthito yogadhāraṇām 8-12
verses.colloquial:
sarva dvaaraani samyamya mano hridi nirudhya cha
muurdhni aadhaaya aatmanah praanam aasthito yoga dhaaranaam 8-12
verses.translation_reworded: Having shut all the gates, having held the mind within the heart, having fixed the life-breath in the head, and absorbed in the practice of concentration,

verses.title: 8.13 om ityekaksharam brahma
verses.sanskrit:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् ।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥ ८-१३॥
verses.roman:
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāmanusmaran
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim 8-13
verses.colloquial:
om ity ekaaksharam brahma vyaaharan maam anusmaran
yah prayaati tyajan deham sa yaati paramaam gatim 8-13
verses.translation_reworded: the person who departs, leaving the body while pronouncing the single syllable OM, the (symbol of) BRAHMAN, and remembering Me, reaches the Supreme Goal.

verses.title: 8.14 ananya-chetah satatam
verses.sanskrit:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः ।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥ ८-१४॥
verses.roman:
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ
tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ 8-14
verses.colloquial:
ananya chetaah satatam yo maam smarati nityashah
tasya aham sulabhah paartha nitya yuktasya yoginah 8-14
verses.translation_reworded: O Partha, I am easy to reach for that always-steadfast YOGI who remembers Me constantly every day and thinks of nothing else.

verses.title: 8.15 mam upetya punar janma
verses.sanskrit:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः ॥ ८-१५॥
verses.roman:
māmupetya punarjanma duḥkhālayamaśāśvatam
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ 8-15
verses.colloquial:
maam upetya punar janma duhkhaalayam ashaashvatam
naapnuvanti mahaatmaanah samsiddhim paramaam gataah 8-15
verses.translation_reworded: Having reached Me, these MAHATMAS (great souls) are not born again into this impermanent home of pain, for they have attained the Highest Perfection, MOKSHA.

verses.title: 8.16 a-brahma-bhuvanal
verses.sanskrit:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन ।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ॥ ८-१६॥
verses.roman:
ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartino'rjuna
māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate 8-16
verses.colloquial:
aa brahma bhuvanaat lokaah punar aavartino'rjuna
maam upetya tu kaunteya punar janma na vidyate 8-16
verses.translation_reworded: O Arjuna, all the worlds, right up to the world of BRAHMAJI, are subject to rebirth. But the one who reaches Me, O Kaunteya, is never born again.

verses.title: 8.17 sahasra-yuga-paryantam
verses.sanskrit:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद् ब्रह्मणो विदुः ।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः ॥ ८-१७॥
verses.roman:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyad brahmaṇo viduḥ
rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te'horātravido janāḥ 8-17
verses.colloquial:
sahasra yuga paryantam ahar yad brahmano viduh
raatrim yuga sahasraantaam te'horaatra vido janaah 8-17
verses.translation_reworded: Those who understand that the day of BRAHMA lasts a thousand YUGAS (aeons), and that the night likewise lasts a thousand YUGAS (aeons), truly know what day and night are.

verses.title: 8.18 avyaktad vyaktayah
verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्ताद् व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे ।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके ॥ ८-१८॥
verses.roman:
avyaktād vyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyaharāgame
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyaktasaṃjñake 8-18
verses.colloquial:
avyaktaad vyaktayah sarvaah prabhavanti aharaagame
raatryaagame praliiyante tatra eva avyakta samjnake 8-18
verses.translation_reworded: When the day arrives, everything manifest comes forth from the unmanifest. When night arrives, it all dissolves back into that very thing called the unmanifest.

verses.title: 8.19 bhuta-gramah sa evayam
verses.sanskrit:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते ।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे ॥ ८-१९॥
verses.roman:
bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate
rātryāgame'vaśaḥ pārtha prabhavatyaharāgame 8-19
verses.colloquial:
bhuuta graamah sa evaayam bhuutvaa bhuutvaa praliiyate
raatri aagame avashah paartha prabhavati aharaagame 8-19
verses.translation_reworded: O Partha, this same multitude of beings comes into existence over and over and is dissolved (into the unmanifest), helplessly, when night comes, and comes forth again when day comes.

verses.title: 8.20 paras tasmat tu bhavo
verses.sanskrit:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः ।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति ॥ ८-२०॥
verses.roman:
parastasmāttu bhāvo'nyo'vyakto'vyaktātsanātanaḥ
yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati 8-20
verses.colloquial:
parastasmaat tu bhaavah anyah avyaktah avyaktaat sanaatanah
yah sa sarveshu bhuuteshu nashyatsu na vinashyati 8-20
verses.translation_reworded: But beyond that unmanifest (AVYAKTA) there truly exists another Unmanifest, which is Eternal and is not destroyed when all beings are destroyed.

verses.title: 8.21 avyakto kshara ityuktas
verses.sanskrit:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् ।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥ ८-२१॥
verses.roman:
avyakto'kṣara ityuktastamāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama 8-21
verses.colloquial:
avyakto'kshara ityuktah tam aahuh paramaam gatim
yam praapya na nivartante tad dhaama paramam mama 8-21
verses.translation_reworded: What is called the Unmanifest and the Imperishable is said to be the Highest Goal (path). Those who reach It never come back. That is My highest abode (state).

verses.title: 8.22 purushah sa parah
verses.sanskrit:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया ।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥ ८-२२॥
verses.roman:
puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā
yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvamidaṃ tatam 8-22
verses.colloquial:
purushah sa parah paartha bhaktyaa labhyas tu ananyayaa
yasya antahsthaani bhuutaani yena sarvam idam tatam 8-22
verses.translation_reworded: O Partha, that Highest PURUSHA, within whom all beings live and by whom all this is pervaded, can be reached by unwavering devotion to Him alone.

verses.title: 8.23 yatra kale tvanavrittim
verses.sanskrit:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः ।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ ॥ ८-२३॥
verses.roman:
yatra kāle tvanāvṛttimāvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ
prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha 8-23
verses.colloquial:
yatra kaale tvanaavrittim aavrittim chaiva yoginah
prayaataa yaanti tam kaalam vakshyaami bharatarshabha 8-23
verses.translation_reworded: Now, O Chief of the Bharatas, I will tell you the time (path) at which YOGINS depart never to return, and also the time (path) at which they depart only to return.

verses.title: 8.24 agnir jyotir ahah
verses.sanskrit:
अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् ।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ॥ ८-२४॥
verses.roman:
agnirjyotirahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam
tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ 8-24
verses.colloquial:
agnir jyotir ahah shuklah shanmaasaa uttaraayanam
tatra prayaataa gacchanti brahma brahmavido janaah 8-24
verses.translation_reworded: Fire, light, daytime, the bright fortnight, the six months of the sun's northern course: those who know BRAHMAN and go by this path go to BRAHMAN.

verses.title: 8.25 dhumo ratris tatha
verses.sanskrit:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् ।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते ॥ ८-२५॥
verses.roman:
dhūmo rātristathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam
tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotiryogī prāpya nivartate 8-25
verses.colloquial:
dhuumo raatris tathaa krishnah shanmaasaa dakshina ayanam
tatra chaandramasam jyotir yogii praapya nivartate 8-25
verses.translation_reworded: Smoke, night, the dark fortnight, the six months of the sun's southern course: the YOGI who goes by these reaches the Moon, the lunar light, and comes back.

verses.title: 8.26 shukla-krishne gati
verses.sanskrit:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते ।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः ॥ ८-२६॥
verses.roman:
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate
ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayāvartate punaḥ 8-26
verses.colloquial:
shukla krishne gatii hyete jagatah shaashvate mate
ekayaa yaati anaavrittim anyayaa vartate punah 8-26
verses.translation_reworded: The Path of Light and the Path of Darkness are both considered to be eternal paths open to the world. By the first, the Path of Light, a person goes and does not return. By the second, the Path of Darkness, he returns again.

verses.title: 8.27 naite sriti partha
verses.sanskrit:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन ।
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन ॥ ८-२७॥
verses.roman:
naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu yogayukto bhavārjuna 8-27
verses.colloquial:
naite sritii paartha jaananyogii muhyati kashchana
tasmaat sarveshu kaaleshu yoga yukto bhava arjuna 8-27
verses.translation_reworded: O Partha, no YOGIN who knows these paths is ever deluded. Therefore, O Arjuna, be steadfast in YOGA at all times.

verses.title: 8.28 vedeshu yajneshu
verses.sanskrit:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव
दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् ।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ॥ ८-२८॥ 

ॐ तत्सदिति श्रीमद्भगवद्गीतासूपनिषत्सु
ब्रह्मविद्यायां योगशास्त्रे श्रीकृष्णार्जुनसंवादे
अक्षरब्रह्मयोगो नामाष्टमोऽध्यायः ॥ ८॥
verses.roman:
vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva
dāneṣu yatpuṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā
yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam 8-28

oṃ tatsaditi śrīmadbhagavadgītāsūpaniṣatsu
brahmavidyāyāṃ yogaśāstre śrīkṛṣṇārjunasaṃvāde
akṣarabrahmayogo nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ 8
verses.colloquial:
vedeshu yajneshu tapahsu chaiva
daaneshu yat punya phalam pradishtam
atyeti tat sarvam idam viditvaa
yogii param sthaanam upaiti chaadyam

om tat sat iti shriimad bhagavad giitaa suupanishatsu
brahma vidyaayaam yoga shaastre shrii krishna arjuna samvaade
akshara brahma yogo naama ashtamo'dhyaayah 8
verses.translation_reworded:
Whatever rewards of merit (the scriptures) declare to come from studying the VEDAS, performing sacrifices, practising austerities, and giving in charity, the YOGIN goes beyond them all. Having understood this (the two paths), he reaches the Supreme, Primeval (Essence).

Thus, in the Upanishads of the glorious Bhagavad Gita, the science of the Eternal, the scripture of Yoga, the dialogue between Sri Krishna and Arjuna, ends the eighth discourse, entitled "The Yoga of the Imperishable Absolute."
